entries.semantics: This supports the conservative common query interval t in [2, 5] for the two displayed fitted relations. It does not identify the exact regression-sample endpoints or a raw sampling grid.
entries.transcription: Supplementary Figure S5 displays the gauge-invariant fitted curve and the superselection-sector fitted curve throughout the shared axis-interior interval from t=2 through t=5. The gauge-invariant displayed fit extends below t=2 and nearly to t=6; the superselection-sector displayed fit extends from t=2 through t=10, but those wider branch-specific extents are not used for the matched query interval.
